scope: synthetic software validation only; not real iPhone accuracy or printed fit
stage_comparison: Identical raw input hashes across stages; separate process per stage. No similarity/rigid alignment.
dimension_gate: abs(error) <= max(0.5 mm, 1% reference length) on full clean exposed bounds; all axes must pass
coverage_definition: Fraction of all exposed analytic union-surface samples within 2mm of reconstructed points. Includes surfaces unseen by camera, so this is conservative full-object coverage, not a guarantee of hidden geometry.
memory_definition: Peak process resident memory including imported native libraries, per fresh process; runtime excludes import and includes reconstruction only.
oracles: Analytic primitive definitions outside scan packages; never passed to production reconstruction.
